description.content:
The Aggregates – Returns package provides returns data aggregated by industry classification, using Morningstar’s Morningstar Global Equity Classification Structure, to give industry-wide averages on a country-by-country basis to use to benchmark an investment’s performance relative to other companies in that industry, industry group, or sector.
The package contains the following datasets:
- Industry Aggregates - Trailing Returns

Most recent and time series data supported.
